credit_metrics.text: EBITDA declined by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} and operating profit by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}, with write-offs on the abandoned third runway project and higher personnel expenses from collective wage increases weighing on the result.
Total debt was stable at {{total_debt@FY2025}}, so gross leverage held at {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, a change of {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}}.
FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, and free cash flow dropped by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} as capital spending absorbed more of the cash generated.
Capex intensity increased by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, against {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} in FY2024.

liquidity_funding.text: The group carries very little debt, so refinancing risk is limited and the liquidity question is about cash generation rather than maturities.
Cash and cash-like investments, undrawn committed facilities and the resulting liquidity to revenue are not disclosed in the fact base for FY2025, so the buffer cannot be sized against revenue.
Customer prepayments are not disclosed for FY2025 either, so the share of the cash balance that is passengers' money cannot be assessed.

peer_positioning.text: Gross leverage is the lowest of the airport peers ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}), against a peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.
The EBITDA margin places the company in the middle of the group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}), in line with the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Capex intensity is above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}, the weakest relative position in the comparison.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} and FFO by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, so the buffer against the investment programme has narrowed.
Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Margins: the EBITDA margin fell by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, with write-offs on the abandoned third runway project and higher personnel expenses from collective wage increases in the base.
Traffic: traffic growth slowed by {{traffic_growth.change@FY2025}} to {{traffic_growth@FY2025}}, which limits the operating leverage behind the charge increases.
